item.title: Bulletin updated at 13:50 HKT 25/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Ma-on will move into inland Guangxi today and weaken gradually. The associated showers will still affect the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. An anticyclone aloft will cover southern China during the weekend and early next week, it will be mainly fine and very hot over the region. With the anticyclone aloft weakening, there will be showers over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
